figures.caption: Cytotoxicity of colistin and antimicrobial peptides against HepG2 cells. HepG2 cells.HepG2 cells were seeded at 3,000 cells/well in 96-well microtiter plates. After incubation for 48 h, DP-C and colistin were added and incubated for an additional 48 h. Cell viability was determined using a Cell Counting Kit-8, with colorimetric changes assessed at OD450 with a microplate reader. Cell survival was expressed as a percentage of the control were obtained as mean ± SD of three independent experiments done in three replicates for each treatment. Significant differences between each concentration and the control (2 µg/mL DP-C and 0.2 µg/mL colistin) were statistically evaluated by Student’s t-test (*p < 0.05, **p < 0.01).
